conf.description: Forescout eyeSight/CounterACT platform-audit / syslog-raw: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: forescout-counteract / platform-audit / syslog-raw. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Forescout integration (event data stream)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
